source.headline: Iran Launched Undisclosed Second Wave of Attacks on U.S. Navy Ships, Sources Say - WSJ

learning_profile.reason: No applicable ACTIONABLE context-aware v2 segment was used to alter confidence; current facts and pre-prediction context dominate.

predictions.mechanism: Renewed direct attacks on U.S. naval assets raise geopolitical and oil-supply risk while a softer DXY supports gold.
predictions.invalidation: Confirmed de-escalation, no follow-on military response, and a sharp reversal lower in crude risk premium.

predictions.mechanism: Europe is sensitive to an energy-price shock; near-$100 Brent and rising yields pressure cyclicals and valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Rapid de-escalation and material decline in Brent and sovereign yields.

predictions.mechanism: Energy inflation and geopolitical risk weigh on broad euro-area equities.

predictions.mechanism: Higher oil, rising Treasury yields and renewed military escalation reinforce risk-off pressure.
